title: Brand Manager Babybel et Kiri - Bel France (W/M)
description:
The Bel Group is a major player in the food industry through portions of dairy, fruit and plant-based products, and one of the world leaders in branded cheeses. Its portfolio of differentiated and internationally recognized brands includes The Laughing Cow®, Kiri®, Babybel®, Boursin®, Pom'Potes® and GoGo squeeZ®, as well as some 30 local brands. Together, these brands helped the Group generate sales of €3.74 billion in 2024.
  
  
Do you want to join a company with strong brands that puts consumers and responsibility at the heart of the decision-making process? Then Bel is made for you!
  
  
Are you bold, pragmatic, and determined? Do you want to contribute to the transformation of an international agri-food company? Them come join us and measure the impact of your talent and energy in realizing an ambitious and sustainable company project!
  
  
**#IWorkForAllForGood**
**LOCATION & START DATE**

* Permanent contract (CDI) starting from November 2026
* Location: Suresnes, Bel Group Headquarters

**YOUR MISSION**
**Responsibilities**
Reporting to the Marketing Director and under the responsibility of the Group Brand Director, the
**Brand Manager Babybel & Kiri**
will be responsible for the following:
  
  

* Strategic Leadership
* Build a robust business and market diagnosis to identify key challenges and growth opportunities across the brands (combined turnover of €165M).
* Analyze consumer and shopper behaviors, identify knowledge gaps, and derive actionable recommendations to drive business growth.
* Monitor market trends, assess their implications, and recommend appropriate actions.
* Analyze the financial health of the business and identify improvement levers across the entire P&L.
* Define the short- and mid-term strategy for the brands/businesses in close collaboration with global teams.
* Portfolio Management & Revenue Growth Management (RGM)
* Manage the product portfolio of the assigned brands.
* Contribute to pricing, promotion, and distribution strategies in collaboration with the Commercial Strategic Planning team.
* Own the RGM strategy, including pricing, promotions, portfolio architecture, and productivity initiatives, while ensuring alignment with commercial and global teams.
* Define innovation and renovation strategies (growth drivers, roadmap, and guidelines) for the brands.
* Lead recommendations with Global teams responsible for development and take full ownership of market launches, including the selection and execution of plans required to ensure their success.
* P&L Management
* Define and manage the marketing budget required to support the strategy while ensuring brand profitability.
* Establish annual objectives (budget targets) for the brands and define action plans to achieve them across the full P&L.
* Media & Activation
* Develop and execute 360° marketing plans with relevant content and touchpoints targeting priority audiences.
* Coordinate media and creative agencies (including packaging, shopper marketing, social media, influencer marketing, and PR) to ensure high-quality briefs and impactful activations.
* People Management
* Lead a team of 5 people (3 Brand Managers and 2 interns).
* Ensure strong team performance and continuous development.
* Demonstrate outstanding leadership behaviors within the team and across cross-functional stakeholders.

**YOUR PROFILE**

* Master's degree (or equivalent professional experience) with at least 7 years of marketing experience, ideally within the FMCG industry, and a solid first experience in people management.
* Experience in a matrix and/or international environment is a strong asset, along with the influencing skills required to operate successfully in a local market within a global organization.
* Strong expertise in retailer and consumer panel data, ad hoc consumer research, and the ability to effectively lead creative development processes with agencies.
* Results-oriented, collaborative, and highly engaged, with a passion for identifying growth opportunities and optimizing business performance.
* Strong people leadership skills, with genuine commitment to team performance, engagement, and development. You know how to balance high standards with care and support.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, agile approach, and comfortable navigating change. You challenge the status quo and proactively propose new ways of working.
* Interest in sustainability and CSR topics, with a personal connection to Bel's mission: "For All. For Good."
* Fluent French and English are required.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive fixed salary paid over 13 months
* Profit-sharing and employee savings plan (PEE)
* Company restaurant
* Additional RTT (working time reduction) days
* Health insurance and life/disability coverage
* Access to a wide range of Social and Economic Committee (CSE) benefits
* Hybrid working policy (remote work available)

If you think that this job is for you, please click now on the button "Apply". The recruitment team of your site will contact you very soon.

title: Apparel Product Category Director W/M
description:
Our client, a leading international player in the sports and outdoor industry, is continuing to expand quickly its Apparel business and is looking for a Global Product Marketing Director – Apparel.

In a context of transformation and hypergrowth, you will join an international organization with the ambition to define and drive the global Apparel product strategy, combining sports performance, innovation and lifestyle trends.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Define and implement the three-year Apparel product strategy, ensuring consistency across the Performance and Sportstyle categories.
* Oversee the entire product lifecycle, from product strategy and range architecture to market launch, ensuring strong alignment with consumer needs.
* Develop an innovative and differentiated product offering, working closely with Design, Development, Innovation, Sourcing and Marketing teams.
* Drive the commercial and financial performance of the category, with responsibility for revenue, profitability and margin targets.
* Lead and develop an international team of 8 to 10 people, while fostering cross functional collaboration and alignment around a shared vision.
* Act as a key ambassador for the Apparel category, strengthening the brand's positioning and relationships with customers, partners and stakeholders across the sports and lifestyle ecosystem.

**Your Profile**

* Over 15 years of professional experience in the international sporting goods, sportswear or outdoor industry, including significant management experience.
* Strong expertise in Product Management, product strategy and Apparel collection development, ideally across both Performance and Sportstyle categories.
* Proven ability to define a strategic vision while ensuring operational execution and strong business performance.
* Strong product sensitivity, with a deep understanding of innovation, consumer trends and brand positioning.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to manage teams and drive cross-functional initiatives in an international environment.
* Strategic mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, strong leadership skills and the ability to drive change.
* Fluent English is essential.

**Location:**
Annecy and/or Paris, France.

title: Directeur Technique Produit (F/H)
description:
****Job Description:****
**Intitulé du poste : Directeur Technique Produit (F/H)**
**Qui sommes-nous ?**
Au sein du Airbus Helicopters Drone Center, né de la fusion entre Survey Copter et Airbus Helicopters, nous concevons, fabriquons et assurons le maintien en conditions opérationnelles de systèmes de drones tactiques légers, destinés à des missions militaires et civiles. Nous couvrons l’ensemble du cycle de vie de ses systèmes, offrant à chacun la possibilité de contribuer pleinement à des projets technologiques et concrets.
  
  
Filiale à 100% du groupe Airbus depuis 2011, elle est le centre d’expertise drones d’Airbus Helicopters, implantée à Pierrelatte (sa maison mère) et à Aix les Milles.
  
  
Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer des sites à taille humaine et des équipes passionnées, tout en profitant d’un cadre de vie privilégié dans la Drome ou les Bouches du Rhône, territoires dynamiques et ensoleillés.
  
  
Pour en savoir plus sur nos produits UAS (Uncrewed Aerial Systems) :
  
  
https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/defence/uas
  
  
**Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble**
**:**
Sur notre site de Pierrelatte, rattaché au Directeur Ligne de Produit Aliaca / Capa-X, vous prenez la Direction Technique de cette gamme de systèmes.
  
  
À la tête d’une équipe de 30 personnes structurée avec des managers de proximité, vous adoptez un management pragmatique et proche du terrain. Tout en vous appuyant sur vos responsables d'équipe pour la gestion quotidienne, vous gardez une vision précise de la technique et du produit pour trancher les arbitrages, débloquer les sujets opérationnels et soutenir l'innovation.
  
  
**Vos missions principales :**

* Arbitrages techniques : garantir la cohérence globale des systèmes en trouvant le juste équilibre (performance, masse, autonomie, coûts, délais, sécurité) sur la base de la réalité du terrain.
* Management & Organisation : encadrer la direction (30 personnes) via vos managers. Piloter le développement des compétences, les recrutements et maintenir une bonne dynamique d'équipe.
* Feuille de route technique : définir la trajectoire R&T et les évolutions produit à moyen et long terme, en alignant la technologie sur la stratégie du Groupe.
* Pilotage & Méthodes : structurer le plan de charge, répartir les ressources et veiller à l'application simple et efficace des processus d'ingénierie (norme EN9100).
* Interface & Coordination : assurer le lien avec les équipes transverses, le groupe Airbus, les sous-traitants et les clients.

**Mobilité :**
Poste basé à Pierrelatte (26). Des déplacements ponctuels sont à prévoir (Groupe, clients, fournisseurs).
  
  
Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d’être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.
  
  
**Qui êtes-vous ?**
Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur (Aéronautique, Avionique, Architecture Systèmes ou équivalent), vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans l'aéronautique ou la défense. Vous avez déjà encadré des responsables d'équipes techniques et piloté des projets d'ingénierie complexes.
  
  
**Ce que l’on reconnait chez vous :**

* Management pragmatique : un style accessible, capable d'allier prise de recul et proximité avec le produit et les équipes.
* Prise de décision : capacité à analyser des compromis techniques complexes et à trancher clairement les choix d'architecture.
* Connaissances métier : solide maîtrise du secteur aéronautique, des systèmes de drones et des exigences qualité (EN9100).
* Organisation : savoir gérer les plans de charge, arbitrer les priorités et animer une direction pluridisciplinaire.
* Communication : esprit de synthèse, rigueur, diplomatie et un anglais professionnel fluide (écrit et oral).

**Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :**

* Bien-être / santé : complémentaire santé et prévoyance santé / décès financées à hauteur de 100 % par Survey Copter, Team Building.
* Avantages financiers : accord d’intéressement, politique salariale annuelle, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, salaire sur 13 mois.

**Type de contrat :**
CDI - Cadre
  
  
**Horaire de travail :**
Forfait 218 jours
  
  
This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
  
  
********Company:********
Survey Copter SAS
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Experience Level:**
Professional
  
  
**Job Family:**
Leadership
  
  
By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
  
  
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.
  
  
Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .
  
  
At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Permanent contract to be filled from September 2026

Position based in Vendôme, in Loir-et-Cher (41), on the TGV line connecting Paris (40 minutes) and Tours (20 minutes).
MAIN MISSIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES
As part of the growing activity within the Babybel Research, Innovation and Development (RID) team, we are recruiting a Process and Product Development Portfolio Manager.
Reporting to the Babybel Europe Development Manager, the Process and Product Development Portfolio Manager will be responsible for:
- managing and developing the full portfolio of Innovation, Renovation and Productivity projects for Babybel products, on a global scope, across the European plants under his/her responsibility, with the support of plant Innovation Technologists;
- directly leading or coordinating selected projects depending on business stakes (priority, resources, scope), in order to deliver them in line with quality, cost and timing objectives.
Key responsibilities
- Process and Product Project Portfolio Management
- Lead, prioritize and arbitrate the project portfolio and the allocation of available resources across the plants under his/her responsibility, according to business and/or strategic priorities.
- Manage trial budgets: monitoring, reporting, recommendation of OPEX reallocations during the fiscal year, and preparation of budgets for Year+1.
- Act as a driving force to feed the Babybel Innovation – Renovation – Saving pipeline through a user-centric approach, taking into account consumer needs in terms of functionality, naturality and CSR challenges, while considering business, regulatory, operational and quality constraints.
- Project management
- Lead Innovation – Renovation – Saving projects autonomously and cross-functionally, in line with Bel Group methodology (processes, project management tools, risk analysis, etc.), in order to ensure On Time / In Full delivery in terms of quality, cost and timing.
- Ensure project deliverables from the exploration phase through to industrial implementation and product launch, with a strong presence on the field whenever needed.
- Develop products by leveraging technical expertise and analytical skills in order to guide, prioritize and select the most relevant solutions based on the project brief and local constraints (processes, raw materials, etc.), with the appropriate level of challenge.
- Ensure proper onboarding of project team members and associated technical contributors (engineering, plant teams, etc.).
- Mobilize the required expertise (packaging, engineering, quality, regulatory, CSR, purchasing, logistics, etc.) and resources (new equipment, RID pilot trials, RID laboratory characterizations) needed to achieve project objectives.
- Co-develop solutions with internal and external partners, challenge technical choices and propose relevant directions.
- Organize and lead field trials in pilot plants, Bel factories or at subcontractors’ sites.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Time to Market and monitor key post-launch performance indicators (experience feedback loop).
- Functional Management, Communication and Activity Steering
- Functionally manage 3 plant technologists under his/her responsibility (prioritization, workload planning, capability building…) regarding RID project deliverables.
- Organize and co-facilitate Plant Development Committees with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Act as the key RID business partner between the plants, the Global Babybel Marketing team and local business teams, notably by coordinating technical feasibility requests.
- Represent his/her portfolio and/or projects in Country, Zone or Brand SteerCo.
PROFILE
Master’s degree in Food Engineering or equivalent (Bac +5 / Master’s level), with at least 10 years of experience, and solid expertise in recipe and/or process development, from technical exploration through to industrial implementation.
Required Skills And Experience
- Strong knowledge of traditional cheesemaking: milk treatment, standardization and transformation processes into cheese (ideally semi-hard / hard cheese).
- Fluency in English, enabling effective work in an international environment.
- Strong technical expertise from exploration to industrial implementation, on both product and process dimensions.
- Proven project management experience from ideation to first production, both in terms of methodologies (planning, risk analysis, agility, reporting, etc.) and ability to work in cross-functional and multicultural teams.
- Ability to foster a positive, supportive and trust-based environment to lead technical teams in industrial implementation projects.
- Ability to drive change, challenge the status quo, and enable collaboration.
- Strong ability to connect with a wide range of internal and external ecosystems.

title: Footwear Product Development Manager - Colors & Materials - Women'S H/F
description:

This role partners closely with Design, Product Merchandising, Sourcing, and Manufacturing to develop scalable, consumer-right color and material solutions that support seasonal strategies and brand objectives.
MAIN REPONSIBILITIES
Product Development Execution
· Manage end-to-end color and material development from design handoff through production approval.
· Ensure material feasibility, manufacturability, performance, and quality standards are met.
· Execute seasonal material and color direction aligned with design intent and category strategy.
